convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for TTM-Trend indicator which is a non-standard/custom indicator, plus has ReOpen logic that re-enters on same signal with position counting, making it moderately complex to convert

other_exits: Signal reversal closes existing position before opening opposite direction

custom_logic_notes: ReOpen logic: EA re-enters trades in the same direction when the TTM-Trend signal persists and the position was closed (e.g. by SL/TP), allowing pyramiding/re-entry on continuation signals. Signal reversal closes opposite positions before entering new direction. The TTM-Trend is a custom indicator similar to a smoothed Heikin-Ashi trend detector with two buffers for up/down trend state.
python_conversion_notes: TTM-Trend is a custom indicator not available as a standard Python library - its algorithm must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented. The TTM-Trend is typically based on ATR-adjusted moving average with color-coded trend state (similar to SuperTrend or Heikin-Ashi smoothed). ReOpen logic requires careful state tracking for re-entry after position closure. New bar detection is critical for correct signal timing.
